csrf_mechanism.xsrf_cookie: XSRF-TOKEN (read from cookie, URL-decoded, sent as x-xsrf-token header)
csrf_mechanism.meta_token: scraped from <meta name="csrf-token"> in homepage HTML, sent as _token body field

captcha.note: No captcha on homepage. curl_cffi impersonation should work fine.

notes: Confirmed 100% identical to tempmailq.com Laravel pattern. Same endpoints, same CSRF mechanism. Can reuse existing _tmq_* logic with just a different BASE_URL. Multiple domains available.
